title: Laptop on a sky peak with a cloud wipe
summary: Clouds part as the camera rises to a laptop balanced on a rocky summit in a blue sky. The laptop lifts off, tilts toward camera and fills the frame, then drops away and clouds sweep back in, so the short clip loops.
use_when: A web product hero shot where one landing screen is the whole message
A short silent loop for a site header, social feed or ad slot
Brands with an airy, sky or lightness theme
Opening a longer film with a device reveal before the feature tour

look.type_style: no overlay type; the only text is the product UI on the laptop screen (headline, prompt box, suggestion chips)

sfx.event: cloud layer sweeps past the camera (open and close)
laptop lifts off the peak and tilts toward camera

structure.shot: empty blue-to-white sky gradient, one soft cloud wisp at the top right edge
a wall of white clouds fills the frame, drops away downward and reveals a laptop resting on a dark rocky summit
structure.camera: dolly up (pedestal rise): laptop enters from the top edge at 0.50 and settles at upper third by 1.00, about 25 % of frame height travelled in 28 fr
structure.motion: cloud layer falls out of frame bottom, easings.outQuint 28 fr (±0.25 s); clouds blurred (near-camera depth); laptop screen already lit, no lid animation

structure.shot: laptop at three-quarter view on the summit, screen shows a landing page with a headline and a prompt box; clouds below
structure.camera: drift: slow continued rise, laptop slides down ~10 % H over 60 fr; scale 1.00 -> 1.10 (screen width 31 % -> 34 % of frame)
structure.motion: easings.inOutSine 60 fr; laptop yaws slightly toward frontal; from 2.75 a gap opens between laptop and peak (lift starts)

structure.shot: laptop lifts off the summit and pitches toward camera so the keyboard comes into view; peak exits frame bottom
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.30 over 38 fr (screen width 34 % -> 44 % of frame)
structure.motion: lift and pitch with springs.heavy 38 fr (overshoot not measurable); roll swings from -8 deg to +6 deg and back to 0 by 4.27 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: laptop near frontal, screen fills the upper two thirds, keyboard cropped by the bottom edge; landing page readable
structure.camera: drift: laptop sways ~6 % W right then back left, scale steady 1.00 -> 0.97
structure.motion: slow yaw sway, easings.inOutSine 52 fr; the screen content is static

structure.shot: laptop tips back and falls out of the frame bottom, leaving empty sky
structure.motion: lid tilts back toward flat and drops out downward, easings.inExpo 15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: empty sky gradient; soft blurred clouds slide in from the top and cover most of the frame, then open again on clear sky
structure.camera: dolly down implied by clouds descending into frame, ~60 % H over 22 fr
structure.motion: cloud layer enters from top, easings.inOutSine 22 fr; blurred crossfade 7.13 -> 7.43 (9 fr) to a sky with clouds at the edges

params.content.screen: one landing-page screenshot at 1512x982 for the laptop screen
params.pedestal: image or drawn shape the laptop rests on (default rocky summit)
params.timing.lift: frame at 30 fps where the laptop leaves the peak (default 90)
params.timing.exit: frame at 30 fps where the laptop falls away (default 180)

notes: One continuous shot from 0.07 to 7.13 s; rows 2-6 split it at state changes (hard-cut in transition_out means no transition effect, not a cut). Sheets give 0.25 s resolution, no 30 fps strip. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Clouds act as a wipe at both ends (proposed term cloud-wipe); laptop lift-and-pitch off a pedestal is proposed term levitate-tilt. The end frame (sky, clouds at the edges) is close to the start frame but not within 2 %, so loopable is false; a rebuild can match them to loop. LaptopFrame is 2.5D: the summit, cloud sprites and the full pitch toward camera need new components.
